div.div: The I, S, B and J immediates are sign-extended from bit 31, so the sign bit is always in the same place. B and J store imm[0] implicitly as zero (targets are 2-byte aligned in the base ISA; this core also requires 4-byte alignment because it has no C extension).

text.tspan: The I, S, B and J immediates are sign-extended from bit 31, so the sign bit is always in the same place. B and J store imm[0] implicitly as zero (targets are 2-byte aligned in the base ISA; this core also requires 4-byte alignment
because it has no C extension).
